Organization Identifier Code

Code representing the company or organization whose data this file represents: used for situations where one user (e.g., a CPA) needs to keep track of multiple organizations' files (e.g., multiple clients). Can be EIN#, client #, internal/external identifier, SIC code. Codes which identifies the entity. Includes the code identifier of the authority issuing the code, a colon, and the code itself. For example, CIK:01234567 for the CIK number issued by SEC EDGAR.
Organization Identifier Purpose
Purpose or role for which the organization identifier is used.
Organization Identifier Issuing Agency
Organization or authority that issued or assigned the organization identifier.
Organization Identifier Description
Text describing the organization identified by the organization identifier. Includes any relevant information about the code itself (e.g. issuing authority).

Reporting Calendar Code
The code used to identify this specific reporting calendar, unique across periods
Reporting Calendar Description
A description of the reporting calendar (associated with the reportingCalendarCode given)
Reporting Calendar Title
A description of the reporting period. The actual beginning and ending dates are found within the 'reportingCalendarPeriod' class
Reporting Calendar Period Type
A code for the type of period involved. Enumerated as: monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, 4-5-4, ad-hoc, other.
Reporting Calendar Period Type Description
A description of the type of period involved.
Reporting Calendar Closed Status
An identifier on whether the reporting calendar is still open for activity. enumerated, "open", "closed", "pending"
Reporting Calendar Purpose
A description of the accounting set of books involved. Uses enumeration from accounting method purpose.
Reporting Calendar Purpose Description
Free format description of the reporting purpose
Reporting Calendar_ Period
A tool to collect a specific set of periods used to summarize results from transactions.
Period ID
An identifier for this period in this calendar
Period Description
A description of this specific reporting period in this calendar.
Period Start Date
The beginning date/time of a period
Period End Date
The ending date/time of a period
Reporting Calendar_ Period Closed Date
The date/time a period has been closed for activity. If this is present with a nill value (xsi:nill="true") then the period is not closed.
Detail_ Measurable

Parent for information regarding measurable items associated with the enclosing entryDetail line. Primary area used for holding performance measures. Based on needs for tracking inventory transactional detail, but suitable for anything assigned to an "account", "reporting bucket" or "code". Can be used to track any movements.
Detail_ Job

Class for holding job related information, separate from jobs represented in account identifier. Would probably only have one jobinfo class for each entry line, but there may be a need to express more than one.
Detail_ Depreciation Mortgage
Parent for information related to depreciation, mortgages, etc.

Measurable Code

Code for measurable item including BP - Business process, FA - Fixed asset/Capitalized item, IN - Inventory, KPI - Metric, NT - Intangible, SP - Supplies, SV-P - Service by employee, vendor or contractor, SV-M - Service by equipment/machinery, OT - Other
Measurable Code Description
Free format description of the measurable code
Measurable Category
Category of the measurable
Measurable Identification
Internal inventory part or SKU number or other code identifier for the measurable.
Schema for Measurable Identification
URI or other identifier for schema with which measurable ID can be validated
Secondary Measurable Code
Second identifier (such as vendor's item number)
Schema for Secondary Measurable Identification
URI or other identifier for schema with which measurable ID Other can be validated
Measurable Description
Text description of measurable (e.g. inventory item or other identifier)
Measurable Quantity
Number of units in this transaction; for non-monetary calculations; can be square footage, number of people, etc.
Measurable Qualifier
Field that can represent grading, inspection codes, ratings and other qualifiers to properly capture PKI/Balanced Scorecard information
Measurable Unit of Measure
Description of unit: e.g. each, case, dozen, etc. ISO standard coding recommended.
Measurable Per Unit Cost/Price
Per unit price of the measurable. Although one might expect that measurableQuantity * measurableCostPerUnit = amount, this is not mandated except by external rules sets.
Measurable Start Time
Start time of the duration being measured
Measurable End Time
End time of the duration being measured
Measurable Active
Boolean to indicate whether the measurable is active (="true") or inactive (="false")
Job ID

Associated job number or code. This could be built into the account, but many systems maintain a separate job coding system. Use primarily if job identification is a separate system, and not considered part of the chart of accounts.
Job Description
Description of job
Job Phase
Job code, phase, activity. Allows greater granularity than a simple job number. Although the core only reaches down from job to phases, this can be customized to extend down to cost codes.
Job Phase Description
Description of Job code, phase, activity
Job Active
Boolean to indicate whether the job is active (="true") or inactive (="false")
Depreciation Mortgage Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction (e.g. federal, state, local): e.g. US Federal, Province of Québec, other identifier. Enumerated as: F, federal, S, state, L, local, other.
Depreciation Method

Type of depreciation method: used for information about the loan percentage for loan or the depreciation method. This is used for informational purposes only. Examples of entries are "20%", "5 year DDB" (Double Declining Balance).
Depreciation Mortgage Life
Length of life in number of periods.
Depreciation Mortgage Description
Description of each item related to depreciation, mortgage, loan, credit facility, etc.
Depreciation Mortgage Start Date
Start of the applicable period of each item related to depreciation, mortgage, loan, credit facility, etc.
Depreciation Mortgage End Date
End of the applicable period of each item related to depreciation, mortgage, loan, credit facility, etc.
Depreciation Mortgage Amount
Amount of a cost or fee charged for a mortgage, loan, credit facility, etc.
